correctness.rationale: For GEM(α) weights P_j=V_j∏_{i<j}(1−V_i), V_i∼Beta(1,α), the stick-break recursion yields ES=1/(α+1), ET=6/[(α+1)(α+2)(α+3)] and ES²=(α+6)/[(α+1)(α+2)(α+3)] for S=ΣP_j²,T=ΣP_j⁴. Independent spherical directions imply E(Q_d|P)=S, Var(Q_d|P)=2(S²−T)/d and hence E(Q_d−S)²=2α/[d(α+1)(α+2)(α+3)]. For fixed truncation, representing directions as Gaussian vectors divided by their Euclidean norms shows a multivariate ordinary CLT over d coordinates for the first coordinate and off-diagonal quadratic terms; odd Gaussian moments cancel mixed covariance, giving conditionally independent N(0,S) and N(0,2(S²−T)). Truncation tails vanish in conditional L² using Σ_{j>K}P_j²→0, yielding the stated joint stable conditional convergence. Independently checked beta recursions, finite-d kurtosis, and sphere covariance; the bounded diagnostics are not an asymptotic proof.

originality.rationale: Guéneau–Majumdar–Schehr, arXiv:2602.08436v2, already derives the physical model, Kesten/stick-breaking representation (Eq.43), arbitrary-coordinate moments (Eq.47), radial moments (Appendix A3), and explicit radial laws at d=1,2,3. These premises and finite moment consequences are credited. Its inspected main sections and appendices do not state the joint P-conditional high-d Gaussian limit with independent first-coordinate and radius fluctuations and the nonconcentrating random radial limit. General Dirichlet mean laws do not automatically give this two-statistic stable CLT. Priority is provisional given broad stochastic-geometry literature.
residual_risks: Other probabilistic studies of Dirichlet-process spherical means may state a generic conditional Gaussian fluctuation theorem that specializes to this model.
The finite-d moments are partially derivable from prior arXiv:2602.08436; originality rests principally on the coupled stable limit, not on the known stationary representation.
